## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO; see CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `cargo fmt -- --check`, `cargo clippy --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --locked` pass.
- [ ] Hot-path change or performance claim: a benchmark doc under `docs/bench/` that follows CONTRIBUTING.md (hardware, versions, N runs, raw data).
- [ ] Behaviour change: docs and CHANGELOG.md updated.
